title: Gamerspro.io
tagline: We are creating the #1 NFT Marketplace for Gamers and Esports League
description:
Gamerspro infrastructure helps beginners become professional players by offering coaching services, the ability to create your own NFT as collectable and track your progress, and take part in a live tournament.  

As MVP, Gamerspro is introducing the gameplay NFT marketplace. As gamers improve their skills, a history of gameplay NFTs will be a treasured memory.
how_its_made: It's built using Ethereum smart contracts, Polygon network, react.js, and next.js / ipfs.  We used hardhat to start the development process. We separated out into react components to develop the project.  Under the hood, env file to help interact with matic.  The sponsors include IPFS which helps to store our NFT.  Also, polygon helps with the transaction price.
